This looks fine but we don't do conventional commit format in this repo. See the git history or https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/blob/main/docs/commit-messages.md for our style.

Could you amend the commit, changing the style?

Amended the commit message to follow docs/commit-messages.md (subject is now `cmd/tailscale/cli: honor --socket in debug local-creds`). The tree is unchanged; only the message was rewritten, and the PR title now matches.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
